cine.subtitle: Nature words
cine.title: Five words for a morning walk

say: Five beautiful English words for a morning walk in nature. How many do you know?
ar: خمس كلمات إنجليزية حلوة لمشية الصبح في الطبيعة. كم وحدة تعرف؟

cine.meaning: the first light of the morning

say: Dawn. The first light of the morning.
Meadow. A field full of grass and flowers.
ar: Meadow: مرج، أرض مليانة عشب وورد.

cine.meaning: green, thick and full of life

say: Lush. Very green, thick, and full of life.
Serene. Calm, peaceful, and quiet. The lake was serene at dawn.
ar: Serene: هادي وساكن. البحيرة كانت هادية وقت الفجر.
